title: Why Rain Makes Charmander’s Tail Steam Without Killing Its Flame
premise: Rain makes steam spout from Charmander’s tail, yet a healthy tail flame can keep burning when wet.
audiencePromise: Follow Charmander’s rainy tail paradox from a hot-place preference to its life-force flame.
openLoop: If rain makes Charmander’s tail steam, how can its flame stay lit?
payoff: The steam is only half the clue: Charmander’s tail reflects its life force, and a healthy flame burns vigorously even when wet.
engagementQuestion: Life gauge or mood gauge: what defines Charmander’s flame?

voice.instructions: Warm, urgent, and curious. Start with a sharp contradiction, then slow down for the life-force reveal. End with a thoughtful challenge.
